alerts.description: Fires when more than 3 activity spans fail in a 5-minute window across the genvora-worker service.

annotations.summary: High error rate in genvora audit pipeline
annotations.description: {{ $labels.operation_name }} has {{ $value }} errors in the last 5 minutes. Check the SigNoz traces tab for failure details.

clickhouse.query: SELECT countIf(status_code = 'ERROR') AS error_count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name LIKE 'activity.%' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) HAVING error_count > 3

alerts.description: Fires when the p95 latency of fetch_page activity exceeds 30 seconds, indicating target sites are slow to respond or Playwright is hanging.

annotations.description: fetch_page p95 latency is {{ $value }}ms (threshold: 30000ms). This may indicate slow target sites or Playwright resource issues.

clickhouse.query: SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration / 1000000) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_span_list WHERE service_name = 'genvora-worker' AND operation_name = 'activity.fetch_page' AND start_time >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) HAVING p95_ms > 30000
